Path 2, agent runtimeGOALS §3.3

kagent

Agents as Kubernetes resources, not scripts on a laptop.

WHAT IT IS

A CNCF project that defines agents, their tools and models as CRDs and runs them as cluster workloads, with MCP tool support. It reached 1.0 with agent-substrate support at the show.

WHAT SETS IT APART

The lowest-commitment way to make an agent a first-class workload with RBAC, namespaces and GitOps. Floor demo: kagent plus Claude tuning Karpenter.

WHERE WE STAND

A phase 3 candidate: whether we stay on Jenkins or move execution to a Kubernetes-native controller, decided with 2027's data.

kagent Contribfest; "Kagent 1.0 with Agent Substrate", KubeCon NA 2026

TRIAL

kagent: Agents as Kubernetes resources, not scripts on a laptop. Where we stand: A phase 3 candidate: whether we stay on Jenkins or move execution to a Kubernetes-native controller, decided with 2027's data. Our day-one notes had kagent in the top three, and it held up all week. The platform plan deliberately starts on Jenkins and keeps this as the option.
